latestCommit.description:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"mitsevox"} -->
_Requested by **Lucas** · [project
thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01SU1kLYmWeT4ejAYnBNpQjs?thread=cmsg_01SU1kLYmWeT4ejAYnBNpQjs9tHa7woX9xn9uXyAo2CtXi)_

## Scope

This PR follows #1131. The shared site's map format used to drop NFL's
per-file and per-function evidence. Site #17 (`f972e8b7`) added
`map-v2`, which carries that evidence. This PR makes the report-v1
package keep it, because Lucas doesn't want those fields lost when the
old Pages site retires.

- **`tools/report_v1.py`:**
  - `map.json` is now `schemaVersion: 2`.
- Map nodes keep `source`, `comparison_source`, `complete`,
`auto_generated`, `boundary` and `scope` instead of stripping them.
- map-v2 requires any node that carries evidence to declare its `type`.
    - Top-level map files get `file`.
- An untyped child that carries evidence gets `group`. Today these are
the 882 "Other bytes in …" ranges that name their source.
- Nodes without evidence get no new type, functions keep theirs, and
sections are unchanged.
  - Any other field the map contract doesn't define is still dropped.
- **`baseline.yml`:** the pinned site packager moves from `f91cd535` to
`f972e8b7`, the first site revision that validates map-v2.
- **Tests and CONTRIBUTING:** the map test now checks three things:
evidence is kept, types are declared only where evidence needs them, and
unknown fields are dropped. The test fixture now uses valid evidence
values.

Validation:
- This repo's real `progress.json` packaged as `map-v2` and passed the
pinned packager at `f972e8b7`.
- Every evidence field survives with the same counts as in
`progress.json`: `source` 6,710, `comparison_source` 8,513, `complete`
1,045, `auto_generated` 238, `boundary` 1,037, `scope` 1,037.
- `python3 -m unittest discover -s tests` passes: 340 OK. The author's
checkout skips 3 (live receipts); a clean checkout skips 22, because
those need CI tools.

**Site impact:**
- This changes the `baseline.yml` blob to `98a97409…`. The site policy
must approve it along with the step-2 registration.
- Measured numbers, function identities, timeline and contributors are
unchanged.
- Now that the evidence is published, an evidence value map-v2 rejects
fails packaging. That failure fails the job, which holds back the Pages
deploy. For example, `tools/progress.py` can emit `scope:
"measured-ranges"`; the committed config never produces it today.

## Review

- Hostile: **SHIP** on 6d921d8b:
https://github.com/mitsevox/nflstreet2/pull/1132#issuecomment-6406053320
- Accuracy: **PASS** on 6d921d8b:
https://github.com/mitsevox/nflstreet2/pull/1132#issuecomment-6406020894

Both reviewers raised non-blocking notes, left as they are:
- The code comment says "names its source" where the code checks any
evidence field. The code is correct for today's data.
- No unit test asserts that existing function types are kept. The
packager would catch that regression.
- The `group` default would also reach section children, but sections
carry no evidence.
